$comment: GENERATED from hadron-cli internal/skilldoc by the #1177 fixture generator (scripts/skilldoc-fixtures/). The hash / render / renderParseRoundTrip sections were REGENERATED at 1d8ca46 for #1235 (§4a: the node id leads the hash), which changed EVERY digest in them — an empty id contributes the empty string rather than being skipped, so pre-§4a inputs move too. render and renderParseRoundTrip are kept NAME-ALIGNED because the round-trip test looks its inputs up in render by case name, and renderParseRoundTrip records what Go READ BACK (post-NormalizeBody). Sections not listed still date from 973cd1f. Language-neutral: the Go and TypeScript suites both load this file, so a port that diverges reds rather than passing its own restatement of itself. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.  D12 (2026-09-19) retired name derivation and the org prefix, so the deriveName and validPrefix sections were removed; validName survives and now validates a STORED name.  The `lint` and `lintCollisions` sections were generated later, at 1a8036b (recorded separately as lintSourceCommit): the earlier sections predate D12, and regenerating them wholesale would have mixed a re-measurement into a port. Both commits are on main; neither section has been hand-edited.  #1289 (2026-09-23): `lintCollisions` is now REGENERATED by genfix.go at 3c30a38 (hadron-cli#678, where Go counts enabled declarations only), stamped separately as lintCollisionsSourceCommit; its inputs are authored in genfix (collisionCases) and now carry enable, since pre-#1289 inputs had none and would have stopped colliding on both sides. `lint` stays at lintSourceCommit. The same run restamped sourceCommit to 3c30a38; the hash / render / renderParseRoundTrip bytes it recomputed are unchanged.  #1292 (2026-09-23): `declared` is now REGENERATED by genfix at e67ff80 (hadron-cli#679, where an unknown exports key is never shape-checked), stamped declaredSourceCommit, and each case gains `unknown` (Go UnknownHostKeys, UTF-8 byte order). Its two ordering cases now expect an empty `malformed` and carry their order in `unknown`. The same run restamped sourceCommit and lintCollisionsSourceCommit to e67ff80 with every other section byte-identical.  #1292, @copilot on PR #1296: `lintUnknownHostKeys` is GENERATED by genfix at e67ff80 (stamped lintUnknownHostKeysSourceCommit) from keys authored in genfix, chosen for the characters Go %q and JSON.stringify quote differently, and pins the warning message word for word.  #1315 (hadron-cli#712): `lintReserved` is GENERATED by genfix at dc6e660 (stamped lintReservedSourceCommit) from nodes authored in genfix (reservedCases), and pins Claude's reserved `synced` name through Go's Lint, word for word. A section of its own so `lint` stays at lintSourceCommit. The same run restamped sourceCommit, lintCollisionsSourceCommit, declaredSourceCommit and lintUnknownHostKeysSourceCommit to dc6e660, with every other section byte-identical.
